    BO13a §2.2.5: the two parts of a split contour are arrows #

    For a long σ with a contour (v₁ v₂, w), ρ = V₁ ≫ ρ' its valley neighbour and ρn = r ≫ V₂ its peak neighbour:

    • MulBasis.arrow_v1: v₁ = B α with B nonempty gives the Ẽ₈ tree F95A in P/σ (with the next four entries σ₂, ρ₂, σ₃, ρ₃ of the chain);
    • MulBasis.arrow_v2: v₂ = β C' with C' nonempty gives the Ẽ₈ tree F95B in P/σ (with the previous four entries).
    • MulBasis.arrow_v2f: the same with the next four entries (tree F95C), when v₁ is the longest prefix through which ρ factors.
